title: Native ordinary realization tensor and Hom data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a scheme $X$, and use the native finite-extension-valued continuous coefficient ring and normalized integral/common-field realization $R$ of [def-sf-locally-finite-adic-realization-data]. Its ordinary ring sheaf is the recorded section ring, and its ordinary module category is [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define the ordinary realization to be $R.J$ followed by the exact derived section-module functor; define its bounded constructible target by transport of the existing native bounded constructible predicate through that section functor. Use the raw common-stage category of [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and exactly the tensor and permitted internal Hom of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. When $\ell$ is invertible on $X$, a tensor datum consists of the ambient closed tensor, K-flat models, coefficient unit and signed symmetric coherence of [def-zl-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal-data], a natural tensorator and coefficient-unit isomorphism for the ordinary realization, and their associativity, both unitor and symmetry equations. Require its evaluation-transpose map on every permitted Hom pair to be invertible in the ambient derived category. Define this map as the actual closed transpose of the tensorator followed by realized evaluation, using the normalized source evaluation of [def-sf-adic-closed-reindexing-maps]. Define its Hom laws to be naturality in every permitted pair morphism, the module-evaluation square and preservation of every transpose for every test object. These are data and predicates only; no existence is asserted.
